title: Find the location of a manual page
summary: Use `man -w` to see where the manual page file for a command is stored on your system, instead of displaying its content.

steps.explain: Run `man -w` followed by the command name to print the file path of its manual page.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The name of the command whose manual page location you want to find.

alternatives.explain: You can also use the long option `--where`.
